name: clinica-vet-pro
description: Clínica Vet Pro — bulário, calculadoras e casos clínicos veterinários (app Android via Capacitor)

scripts.android:init: npm run prepare-web && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare-web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
